chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man, short black curly hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers, white sneakers
chars.FRIEND: a young Moroccan man, shaved sides with a short quiff, wearing a red-and-white varsity jacket over a white t-shirt, blue jeans
chars.GIRL: a young Moroccan woman, long wavy dark brown hair, wearing an oversized lilac denim jacket and a long black skirt, small crossbody bag
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a grumpy middle-aged Moroccan man with a grey moustache, wearing a striped brown djellaba and a white knitted cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night street in Casablanca near a tram stop, the GIRL shrugs worriedly with open palms explaining she has no way to get home, the FRIEND listens beside her, warm street lights

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night Casablanca street, the FRIEND smiles confidently and points down the street toward apartment buildings, the GIRL looks where he points, curious

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night street, the NARRATOR makes a friendly inviting gesture, the GIRL tilts her head thinking, a lit tram passing in the blurred background

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night street, the GIRL laughs and gives a thumbs up saying okay, the FRIEND grins excitedly, playful mood

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, the NARRATOR, the FRIEND and the GIRL walk together along a Casablanca sidewalk toward a taxi stand, joking, seen from the front

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a cramped red Moroccan petit taxi at night, the NARRATOR, the FRIEND and the GIRL squeezed together on the back seat, comic squashed expressions, city lights through the windows

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, at the entrance door of an old Casablanca apartment building, the FRIEND holds a finger to his lips whispering shhh to the GIRL, tense comic mood

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Dim building stairwell at night, the NARRATOR and the GIRL tiptoe barefoot up the stairs holding their sandals in their hands, wide nervous eyes

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Dim stairwell landing at night, the NEIGHBOUR's apartment door is open a crack and the NEIGHBOUR peeks out suspiciously, one raised eyebrow, light from inside his flat
